facts: Database name Greco & Wozniak P.A. The website name is Greco, Wozniak & Ruiz-Carus, P.A. Downtown Tampa. Address 501 North Morgan Street Suite #200, Tampa, FL 33602. Phone 813-223-7849. Website https://grecowozniakpa.com/.

The site says free consultation, Hablamos español, and no fees unless you win. Practice areas named on the homepage: medical malpractice, diagnosis error, cancer misdiagnosis, surgical error, personal injury, car accidents, truck accidents, motorcycle accidents, and wrongful death.
Attorneys named on the homepage: Mac A. Greco, Jr., Mac A. Greco, III, Andrew J. Wozniak, and Isaac R. Ruiz-Carus. The page labels Mac A. Greco, Jr. and Isaac R. Ruiz-Carus as board certified.
Office hours: Monday - Friday 9:00am - 5:00pm, Saturday 9:00am - 12:00pm, Sunday CLOSED.
The homepage also prints experience and verdict figures that do not match each other, and it includes placeholder headlines. Those figures are not repeated here.
